notes.title: Debug and enhancements patch
notes.notes:
Renewed the splash screen
Fixed navigation issues and small bugs here and there
Fixed campfire event skipped when clicking on cook after discarding a soup
Cards that clean using protection now add power bonus
Fixed missing tooltips in help mode
Allow main music to play in the lobby and the house music only in the garden and kitchen
Fixed bold Asian languages fonts
Optimized some more textures

notes.title: Updates notes for patch of May 15th 2025
notes.notes:
NEW!
Added a (?) menu in the action scene that shows all tooltips under the characters particularly for players using controllers.
Added Kickstarter backers skins.
The "Hidden" effects now shows a funky bush to visually show the character is not targetable. 
Feedback on the "cherry" card that now becomes grey when it does nothing and black when it gives negative poser

Fixes
- Translation fixes and improvements
- Asian fonts: fixed missing characters and resolution issues
- Build size optimization
- Tooltips fixes
- Fixed max level rewards appearing after every game at max level
- Screen resize not saved in player preferences

- Various small asset improvements

notes.title: Big small patch
notes.notes:
In this patch, we:
- Allowed steam achievement overlay and runtime update
- fixed - hopefully, achievement issues. Your achievements in the game that were not updated in steam should fix themselves by visiting the "achievements" screen.
- fixed losing navigation issues with controller
- reduced build size with some asset optimization
- added colors to the map and removed map tooltips that were mostly for testing purposes
- implemented saving the size of the window for people playing in window mode
- fixed some typos here and there
- fixed wrong tooltip displayed on spikes intention from "raises mushroom" to "will buff"
- Added alternative hidden skins on some of Nif Nif cards made by kickstarter super backers to unlock
- fixed collection - card screen text (remaining wins) not updating
- fixed missing UI sounds

edit: 
- fixed black on one side grey on other side on ultra wide screens
- fixed wrong Nif Nif poses in the tutorial
As always, please let us know if you see anything else

notes.title: Big News: Release Date, New Demo, and Steam Next Fest!
notes.notes:
🚀 Mark Your Calendar: Release Date Announced!
The wait is almost over—our game officially launches on April 1st, 2025! No, this isn’t an April Fool’s joke (we promise), but we do like this date. We’re so excited to finally share the full experience with you.

But you don’t have to wait until April to get your hands on the game...

🎮 Steam Next Fest Starts February 24th
We’re thrilled to be part of Steam Next Fest! Starting in just 3 days, you’ll be able to try out our brand-new demo. It’s packed with fresh content and gives you a real taste of what the final game will feel like (though it’s level-locked). Don’t miss it!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44749187/e1eefb59cd8a3d5a683d0418fc60e2d8e5b71f8e.jpg[/img]

🛠️ What’s New in the Demo?
We’ve been hard at work improving the game since the last demo, and there’s a ton of cool new stuff for you to check out:

Garden and Kitchen Minigames: Get your hands dirty in the garden or whip up something tasty in the kitchen!

Playable Character: You can now play as Cat ! 

New Story Events: More variety, better visuals, and improved writing.

Loading Screen Tips: Illustrated tips that give you insight into the lives of Nif Nif and Cat.

Card Skin Variants: Win with a card multiple times and unlock stylish new looks for it!

We’d love to hear what you think about all these additions—your feedback is super valuable as we polish things up for launch.

🌍 Now Available in 11 Languages!
We’re making sure as many players as possible can enjoy the game. The demo (and full game) now supports:
English, French, Portuguese, Spanish, Russian, German, Italian, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, and Korean.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44749187/ac776b3b244420771e96fe6e5c11be08c359e1dd.jpg[/img]

If you spot anything off in your language while playing, please let us know—we’re eager to make every translation perfect!

That’s all for now! Don’t forget to check out our demo during Steam Next Fest (February 24th–March 3rd), and let us know what you think. The countdown to April 1st is officially on—thank you for being part of this journey with us!

See you soon,
❤️ The Nif Nif Team

notes.title: 🐽 Nif Nif Kickstarter and demo is almost over! Big demo update!
notes.notes:
As a piglet who loves to 🧹 clean up 🧹 goo and save the forest, I need your help more than ever! The animals are in danger. Only you can help me save the day!

There are[b] only 2 days left[/b] to support Nif Nif on [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/springfox-games/nif-nif?ref=313qj1]Kickstarter[/url]! Your contribution will help us unlock exciting new features and content, like more animals to clean and more soups to slurp. 

We are adding stretch goals to our Kickstarter campaign. The more we raise, the more awesome features we can add to the game, such as new levels and monsters.

[b]Our demo is available until this Sunday only![/b]. Don't miss your chance to try it out and see what Nif Nif is all about!

Our new [url=https://discord.gg/a8cf2S7sWe]Discord [/url]server is now live! Join the community, chat with other players, and get the latest news on Nif Nif's development.

For those of you support Nif Nif on Kickstarter, we have some special news:

- You'll get [b]early access to the closed beta[/b] at the end of September 2024. This means you'll be among the first to play the full game and help us test it out. 🎉🎉🎉

We've also made some [b]big updates to our demo[/b]:

- You can now try out 🐱 [b]the cat[/b] 🐱 and the unlock system and some new skins! Let us know what you think!
- We've fixed a bunch of bugs thanks to your feedback. Your help is invaluable!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44749187/a762c7e863fbd6f3b1e865fefc54b4fc6234a36b.gif[/img] 

Remember, your support is crucial to the success of Nif Nif's adventure. Let's make this game the best it can be together!

Follow us on your favorite social media for more updates and behind-the-scenes content.

Let's clean up the world together! 🧹

🐷 Nif Nif 🐷
